annotations.derivable_answer: In AI-generated fiction, 'formal range' specifically means the dispersion and coordination among measured stylistic features (not narrative structure). 'Overclosure' describes a corpus-level condition where generated texts remain locally fluent and coherent but exhibit an unusually restricted tendency across measured formal dimensions. 'Variance overclosure' means novels differ very little from one another across individual features (lexical diversity, sentence length, readability), whereas 'correlational overclosure' is an exploratory hypothesis that features not mechanically related become more strongly coordinated across texts than in human comparators. They differ because a corpus can be variance-restricted without its variables becoming interdependent, or vice versa.
